in_marathi.name: Sanku
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sanku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sanku is derived from the Sanskrit word 'San', which means 'wealth' or 'prosperity', and 'Ku', which means 'god'. Thus, Sanku can be interpreted as 'God of Wealth'.

in_bengali.name: Sanku
